claims.immutable_images: Exact supplied LOCAL images, stopped-container binary/provenance copies and trusted digest comparison; no pull/build.
claims.owned_topology_auth: New nonce-labelled internal network and private volumes, real synthetic CLI auth; only verified owned identities cleaned.
claims.two_spaces_auth: Actual named configs/current grants and persisted GET baseline (security/provider/model/dimensions/purpose/skill/processing) compared after pending reopen, clone fallback, restore, replay and retention; same-token own-space positive and unauthenticated/wrong-space/path-header negatives.
claims.pending_metadata_restart: Explicit normalized Metadata acceptance with disabled workers; original operation/head survive SIGKILL and persistent-store reopen; actual workers publish required Metadata state.
claims.cold_clone_missing_journal: Stopped original data/config and paired DB cold-cloned before negative; new journal cannot ready an established clone; original data unchanged and original journal positive recovery succeeds.
claims.clean_registered_restore: Registered backup payload copied and independently byte-count/SHA-256 checked; restores exact baseline source/head/operation; published replacement and extra-source canary do not merge into restored state.
claims.original_journal_replay: Completed real public erase followed by old-backup restore with original journal; source absent after first observed Ready, independent second space equal. Public replay only; not independent physical-source inventory, continuous visibility-window proof, or OB3 acceptance.
claims.bounded_backup_retention: Actual five-second manifest deadline elapses; startup cleanup removes exact manifest/data files and restore refuses. No fake clock or modified manifest.

verdicts: Every case is pass/fail/not_executed for one backend. Any failure, skip, cleanup uncertainty or absent required case prevents product_acceptance. Mocks never qualify a product.
schema_limit: Record source/binary/backend and actual readiness verification. Stored migration checksums are not exposed by HTTP and are not invented.
disk_limit: Free-space samples before image work and every launch; no claim of a hard named-volume quota or continuous disk monitoring.
sensitivity: Actual runs are centrally allocated later, under root's shared-host scheduling. Source/mock work launches no image or service.
bootstrap_authority: Actual CLI global operator: management scopes only, no data clearances or spaces. Named service/one-space tokens: explicit spaces, default level-zero clearance and actual current grants. Config administration envelopes use policy default/level 0, the supported fresh global bootstrap; custom-policy/classified bootstrap is not qualified.
